issues.problem: Comment says the diagonal delay column is mirrored (col in the delay order), but the code does not touch col; the mirroring comes solely from FaRoot's direction:rtl making the CSS grid fill from the right. report.json repeats the same claim.
issues.suggestedFix: Reword to: the grid inherits direction:rtl so DOM-first card sits rightmost; (row+col) delay is unchanged and therefore the wave starts top-right.

issues.problem: Source title is Helvetica 800; Persian uses Vazirmatn 700 and reads noticeably lighter than the original at the same frames (f50, f121).
issues.suggestedFix: Use fontWeight 800 (Vazirmatn is variable) to match the original hierarchy.

issues.problem: Chinese design comments left next to the new Persian header (harmless, not rendered). Bento SVG uses transform:scaleX(-1) on the whole rect rather than a per-path change, which is fine but is the only 'mirror hack' besides Wireframe's scaleX(-1) layers.
issues.suggestedFix: Optional: none required; keep as the upstream record.
